what: The recursion lever on community words: the DFT saving of the half cut (each literal rank-48 head cut by 24 of its 48 axes, job 49 on its array, every other array the full job 73), in OpenAI's exact-arithmetic machine model for the DFT; registered on PR #2979's words (on main), replayed on PR #3945's words and on #3945 with every head kept, and, on that table, the FULL cut (each head removed, job 25 on its array, every other rank-48 block split 24 + 24). Complex side only; no kappa is claimed. Headline: on #2979's words with a table of hosts re-solved for the full cut (A-fc, instance 2979Fc), the full cut prices at b = 1.7887045643e-3, checked by computer, not proved in Lean.

headline.what: A-fc: #2979's words, order, dispatch, plan and template unchanged (the price changes with the table: its own uniform figure is 1.6897030e-3), with a table of hosts re-solved for the full cut (fills/2979Fc/FILL.json.gz, a class solution of a mixed-integer program on #3815's Hall model, placed with #3815's reverse-time placement in a tolerant mode: 9 roles placed in spare bins open at their call, 8 planned width-6 slots left idle); each of the 16,576 literal heads removed (job 73 - 48 = 25 on its array); no other rank-48 block, so nothing is split; every paid block has rank at most 23 < 25
